_comment: Every pebbl store the daily job commits and pushes. Data, not code: adding a
store is a line here, not a copy of the script. Six near-identical copies of a
committer is how five of them quietly drift.
A store belongs here once BOTH are true: its .gitignore is in pebbl's
shared mode (events.jsonl tracked, derived files ignored), and its repo has a
remote to push to. A store with no remote can be committed but not backed up,
so the job refuses to beat for it rather than reporting a backup that did not
pushUser names the gh account whose token can actually push (see
lib-git-auth.sh). Omit it to use whatever gh account is active.
lumr           .pebbl/* is ignored except handoffs.md — needs the shared-mode switch
harold         same, plus its store is 20 entries
frontend-loop  tracked already, but the repo has NO remote
lawyer-tool-rs 85 entries, no remote, and its memory concerns real contracts —
the privacy posture is a decision to make before a transport
